Package gui

Class JoinWaitlistController

java.lang.Object
gui.BaseTerminalController
gui.JoinWaitlistController
public class JoinWaitlistController extends BaseTerminalController
Controller for the Join Waitlist screen in Terminal Mode. This class handles the logic for both Guests and Subscribers to join the restaurant's waitlist or get an immediate table if one is available. In Terminal Mode, the user type is usually pre-determined by the login/identification step in BaseTerminalController.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the controller. This method is automatically called by JavaFX after the FXML file is loaded. It sets up the UI components, visibility based on the current user type, and validation listeners.

    • setupSubscriberView

      private void setupSubscriberView()
      Configures the UI for a Subscriber user. Pre-fills the Subscriber ID and disables guest fields.

    • setupGuestView

      private void setupGuestView()
      Configures the UI for a Guest user. Shows contact fields and disables subscriber fields.

    • updateJoinButtonState

      private void updateJoinButtonState()
      Updates the JOIN WAITLIST button state based on the presence of contact information. Guests must provide at least a phone number or an email to be reachable.

    • handleJoin

      void handleJoin(ActionEvent event)
      Event handler for the "Join" button. Determines the user type and initiates the join process.
      Parameters:
      event - The action event triggered by the button click.

    • performJoin

      private void performJoin(String type)
      Orchestrates the join waitlist logic: validates input, packages the data, and sends it to the server via the client controller.
      Parameters:
      type - The type of user attempting to join ("subscriber" or "customer").

    • onJoinResponse

      public void onJoinResponse(Object response)
      Callback method invoked by ClientController when the server responds to the waitlist request.
      Parameters:
      response - The response from the server, expected to be a TableReservation object or an Integer representing a confirmation code or table ID.
